claim: A handler a few T short of or past two frames decides whether the game gets a frame between notes, so a wrapper on the original handler can change game timing.

evidence.text: A handler a few T short of or past two frames decides whether the game gets a frame between notes; a 300 T wrapper on every interrupt took a death's room from 36 frames to 94.
evidence.quote: A wrapper of 300 T on every interrupt took a death's room from 36 frames to 94.
